decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 0800 hours to 2000 hours Monday to Friday, and 0900 hours to 1600 hours Saturday and Sunday.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used only for the use hereby approved, and will not be used for restaurant uses within A3, bar uses within A4, or hot food takeaway within A5, unless approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use from off license to mixed use of sandwich bar within class A1 and cafe within class A3, and  installation of new shopfront.
